item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":2,"rationale":"The President mandates reinstatement of a policy whose requirements are to be imposed through later agency administration of foreign assistance; the segment does not itself apply an individual funding consequence.","evidence":"reinstate the Presidential Memorandum of January 23, 2017"},{"segment_id":"2","code":2,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretary of State to implement specified funding restrictions through later executive-agency action.","evidence":"to ensure that U.S. taxpayer dollars do not fund organizations or programs that support or participate in the management of a program of coercive abortion or involuntary sterilization"}]}
